label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
headline: Fisherman's Row Wholly Colonial; Callahan's Passage Heaviest Ground
war_summary: The Fisherman's Row line has closed out entirely: the lone Warden square noted in the last edition is gone, and all nine strongpoints there now fly Colonial colors. Callahan's Passage remains the war's heaviest ground, thirteen events in two hours and fifty-eight across the day, The Latch alone accounting for thirty; the tally holds nine Warden squares to one Colonial. Stlican Shelf has shifted against the Warden since the previous report, two squares now laid waste, leaving five Colonial and two Warden after fifty-one events, with Breaker Town bearing thirty of them. The Weathered Expanse has cooled — forty-seven events in the day but only three in the last two hours, its split steady at six Colonial, two Warden and one waste. Nevish Line holds seven Warden squares to one Colonial under continued fire. Mooring County draws the day's heaviest losses, some 4,400 Colonial and 4,800 Warden casualties, its line eleven Warden squares to one Colonial. Linn Mercy, now quiet, stays wholly Colonial. Across some 430 strongpoints the Colonial banner flies over roughly 300.

colonial_reinforce.reason: The Latch has changed hands repeatedly on the Callahans front in the last 24h (multiple Colonial losses and rebuilds), and Warden casualty output in the region over the last 2h exceeds Colonial output, so this exposed Colonial town is the most likely to be demolished again; strengthening it preserves the Colonial foothold and rebuild tempo.

colonial_attack.reason: Crumbling Post is the most active flip point in the packet, with several ownership changes in the last few hours, and Warden casualty rates there are higher and rising faster than Colonial rates, indicating the Colonials can keep destroying and rebuilding it; pressing it keeps the front moving in Colonial favor.

warden_reinforce.reason: Shattered Advance was just lost to neutral and rebuilt by the Wardens within the last hour, and WeatheredExpanse shows the heaviest sustained Warden casualties of the supplied regions (recent 2h and 24h), meaning the Colonial pressure that demolished it has not eased; reinforcing it prevents another immediate loss.

warden_attack.reason: The Wind Hills is the only Colonial-held base in MooringCounty and only recently flipped to the Colonials, while recent Warden casualties in the region are high and accelerating against Colonial casualties; attacking this isolated salient would remove Colonial presence from the county.

label: GLM 5.3 Flash
headline: Fisherman's Row Swept; Stlican Shelf Forts Lie in Ruin
war_summary: Since our last edition the map on Fisherman's Row has been settled: the final Warden holding there has fallen, the region now reading nine Colonial posts to none, with Dankana Post and Eidolo the busiest points in a day of forty-six base events. The Stlican Shelf, static at our last writing, has broken loose — two Warden stations now lie in ruins, the count standing five Colonial, two Warden, two demolished, while Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost together accounted for fifty-one events and casualties climb past ninety the hour. Callahan's Passage remains the war's bloodiest ground, its nine-to-one count unmoved while The Latch alone notched thirty events and two-hour losses topped a thousand a side. The Weathered Expanse holds at six Colonial, two Warden, one in ruin, Frostmarch, Wightwalk, and Crow's Nest still trading blows. Mooring County saw flags move before dawn near The Wind Hills and The Cut, and the Nevish Line has not changed hands since late yesterday yet bleeds steadily on. The Linn of Mercy, by contrast, has gone notably quieter. It is day 422; thirty-four victory towns decide the war, and no victor is named.

colonial_reinforce.reason: The Latch is the most contested town base in the packet, flipping roughly every 15-45 minutes; reinforcing its garrison is the only way to break the capture cycle and hold the southern Callahans approach.

colonial_attack.reason: The Cut is a Town Base I on the isolated southwestern flank of Warden Mooring County; Warden casualties are running well above Colonial casualties and accelerating, so pressure on this lone forward town can unhinge the western line.

warden_reinforce.reason: Shattered Advance was just lost and recaptured within 40 minutes; with Warden casualties far exceeding Colonial losses in Weathered Expanse, digging in here prevents the forward relic line from collapsing again.

warden_attack.reason: Frostmarch has traded hands repeatedly with Wardens winning it back multiple times; the fight there is still at high tempo, so continuing the attack on this relic base is the cheapest way to convert Weathered Expanse momentum into map control.

headline: Passage Holds Hot as Shelf Erupts Anew
war_summary: Since the early morning edition Stlican Shelf has flared to join Callahan's Passage at the head of the wires. The Shelf records 10 changes in two hours and 51 on the day about Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost, standing at two Warden, five Colonial and two neutral, with 3,238 Colonial and 3,164 Warden casualties on the day. Callahan's Passage remains the busiest sector with 13 changes in two hours and 58 on the day about The Latch and the Crumbling posts, holding nine Warden to one Colonial with 12,349 Colonial and 14,330 Warden casualties on the day. The Weathered Expanse posts three changes in two hours and 47 on the day about Frostmarch, Wightwalk and Crow's Nest at two Warden, six Colonial and one neutral with 9,891 Colonial and 15,558 Warden casualties on the day. Fisherman's Row adds three changes in two hours and 46 on the day about Dankana Post and Eidolo, now wholly Colonial. Nevish Line, Mooring County, Linn Mercy and Marban Hollow have gone quiet in the last two hours though their day books still show considerable casualties.
